authorization: User approved interface adaptation, legacy regression, then all 12 frozen diagnostics; 120 s each; no new networks or heuristic experiments.
algorithm: Original M2 energy enumeration then full thermal fallback if global energy winner is not SAFE
diagnostic_addition: Certify every completed deployment's energy minimum, instead of only global leading minima. All costs count; no candidate filtering, frequency changes, or search-ranking changes.
cache_policy: Fresh process and empty scene/candidate caches per case; shared existing Numba disk code cache, loading and any JIT compilation inside wall clock. No data cache transfer.
case_order: load,order,thermal_start declaration order from approved protocol
regression: balanced_forward_preheated/C affine versus original full replay
initial_state: Exact approved per-case vector; no coordinate averaging or DLA label symmetry.
certificate_scope: Exactly 81 concrete bindings and 27^4 frequency sequences; original binary64 peak guard, not directed-rounding formal interval proof.
stop: Stop at complete finite-domain certificate or budget; no extension/no retuning. Classification coverage may remain partial even with optimality proved.
